description: Multi-layer query: CPG, CKG, Delta, Trace, State in a single JSON

query.description: JSON multi-capa: {capa: {filtros}, ...}. Capas: cpg, ckg, delta, trace, state

layer.description: Capa específica a consultar (cpg|ckg|delta|trace|state). Si se omite, consulta todas las capas del query.

data.description: Resultados por capa. Cada capa tiene {ok, total, results, layer}

query_instructions:
The task returns raw data with context per layer. As an agent, you interpret and classify the data.

Available layers:
  - cpg: Code Property Graph — source code nodes and relations
  - ckg: Context Knowledge Graph — decisions, rules, knowledge
  - delta: DeltaGraph — task dependencies and history
  - trace: Tool call history
  - state: Current sprint workflow state

CPG filters for the agent:
  bug:unused_functions  → functions defined but never called
  bug:dead_branches     → dead code via unreachable branches
  bug:missing_returns   → functions missing return in all branches
  security:sqli         → potential SQL injections
  security:command_injection → potential command injection
  trace:funcA->funcB    → call path between two functions

━━ HOW TO CONSUME bug:unused_functions ━━
Each candidate has: function, file, line, is_private, is_method,
  incoming_calls, incoming_imports, parent_class, parent_type

CLASSIFICATION RULES (apply in order):
  1. If incoming_calls > 0 → SKIP (function is called)
  2. If function name appears in registry.register() or engine.register() → dynamic_dispatch
  3. If is_method and parent_class scans self.<name>() in its source → dynamic_dispatch
  4. If name starts with cmd_, _handle_, _query_, _on_, on_ → dynamic_dispatch pattern
  5. If incoming_imports > 0 or parent class is imported → may be public API
  6. If is_private (starts with _) → dead_code (safe to remove)
  7. If not is_private → unintegrated (public API never connected)

ACTION:
  - dead_code: propose removal, no side effects expected
  - unintegrated: ask user if they want to integrate or remove
  - dynamic_dispatch: likely false positive, verify dispatch path

━━ END OF INSTRUCTIONS ━━

cpg.description: Code Property Graph — source code nodes and relations

filters.name: node name
filters.type: node type: file | function | class | module | variable
filters.bug: dead_branches | missing_returns | infinite_loops | uninitialized_vars | taint_paths | data_gaps | unused_functions
filters.security: sqli | command_injection | xss | hardcoded_secrets | code_injection | data_leak | weak_crypto | path_traversal | all
filters.text: free text in node name or label

ckg.description: Context Knowledge Graph — decisions, rules, conventions

filters.node: current node (START | SPRINT | DESIGN | ANALYZE | IMPLEMENT | VERIFY)

notes: Multiple layers can be queried in a single JSON
Filters within each layer combine with AND
To explore available filters use: walker3 tasks/query
